   - Similar to the changes in `arm_cpu.c`, the stack pointer initialization was updated from:
     ```c
     stk = (unsigned short *) stack_start + stack_size;
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     stk = (unsigned short *) (stack_start + stack_size);
     ```

The modifications in both files address the same bug related to the incorrect initialization of the stack pointer. The original code incorrectly calculated the stack pointer by adding the stack size to the pointer without properly considering the pointer arithmetic, which led to setting the stack pointer to the end of the stack instead of the beginning. The changes ensure that the stack pointer is correctly initialized to the start of the stack, thereby fixing the bug consistently across both ARM and MSP430 architectures.
